ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.definitions.manage.delete

Delete the Cross Currency curve definition for the definition Id provided.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.definitions.manage.delete.

delete(id: str, session: Session = None) -> Response

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
id str Yes The identifier of the cross currency definition.
session Session No None session=None. Means default session would be used.

Returns

Response

Example

from lseg.data.content.ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves import definitions
response = definitions.manage.delete(id="334b89f6-e272-4900-ad1e-dfefv")
